title: switching between °C and °F
body:
Hi,
I'm getting a °C reading from my sensor that's like 90(32°C). The thing is it's reading °F instead of °C but xdrip+ is still showing °C behind the reading. I think that the problem is occurring because the sensor is an American sensors and the app is thinking it is a European version because of the fact I'm living in Germany. It would be nice if the app is recognizing the sensor as a European (or American) sensor based on the sensor data or serial number(if that's possible?)

![Screenshot_20200228-213352_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57327565/75585343-26167900-5a72-11ea-89c3-0754734556bf.jpg)

comments.body:
@EJM0 Would you please close the issue?
The temperature reporting format changed with a Dexcom transmitter firmware update.  The reported temperature and resistance, for the same reason, have been incorrect.  With recent releases of xDrip, those two parameters have been removed until the correct format is implemented in xDrip.
